title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service Template Generator
metaDescription: Create compliant privacy policies and terms of service with our easy template. Includes GDPR, CCPA compliance and customizable sections.
description: Generate professional privacy policies and terms of service agreements with our comprehensive template. Includes essential legal clauses, compliance guidelines, and customizable sections for any business type.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content:
We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make a purchase, or contact us. This may include:

• Personal identifiers (name, email, phone number)
• Payment information (processed securely by third-party providers)
• Usage data and analytics
• Device information and IP addresses
• Cookies and similar tracking technologies

We recommend using privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser to limit data collection when browsing our site.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content:
{{company_name}} uses collected information for legitimate business purposes including:

• Providing and improving our services
• Processing transactions and payments
• Sending important updates and communications
• Analyzing usage patterns to enhance user experience
• Complying with legal obligations

We will never sell your personal data to third parties. All data processing is done with your explicit consent or legal basis as required by applicable privacy laws.

sections.heading: Data Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content:
We may share your information only in the following circumstances:

• With your explicit consent
• To comply with legal obligations or court orders
• With trusted service providers who assist our operations (under strict confidentiality agreements)
• To protect our rights, safety, or property
• In connection with business transfers or mergers

We conduct due diligence on all third-party partners to ensure they maintain appropriate data protection standards.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights
sections.content:
Depending on your location, you may have the following rights:

• **Access**: Request copies of your personal data
• **Rectification**: Request correction of inaccurate data
• **Erasure**: Request deletion of your data
• **Portability**: Request transfer of your data
• **Objection**: Object to certain data processing
• **Withdraw Consent**: Withdraw consent at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us at {{contact_email}}. We will respond within the timeframes required by applicable law.

sections.heading: Terms of Service Agreement
sections.content:
By using {{company_name}}'s services, you agree to these terms:

**Acceptable Use**: You may not use our services for illegal activities, spam, or to violate others' rights.

**Account Security**: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.

**Service Availability**: We strive for high uptime but cannot guarantee uninterrupted service.

**Limitation of Liability**: Our liability is limited to the maximum extent permitted by law.

**Termination**: Either party may terminate this agreement with appropriate notice.

sections.heading: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
sections.content:
We use cookies and similar technologies to:

• Remember your preferences and settings
• Analyze site traffic and usage patterns
• Provide personalized content and advertisements
• Ensure security and prevent fraud

**Cookie Types**:
• Essential cookies (required for site functionality)
• Analytics cookies (usage statistics)
• Marketing cookies (personalized ads)

You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings or our cookie consent manager.
